body:
P1 DEPENDENCY OWNERSHIP AUDIT — ACCEPT THE V2 DAG; AMEND THE RECORD SO OWNER AND READINESS ARE NOT INFERRED FROM BEAD STATUS.

Measured live at 2026-08-30T12:xxZ:

START 1, human recall / REB: bd-01M184XP908JX51S3ZYFX20HC7 is open. Agents may research and present the disposition table, but the binding recall-corpus REB decision is owner-only. No agent assignment can satisfy this edge. Record owner authority, not merely a bead assignee.

START 2, NFRD intake + 57/28/28 split: bd-01M17MT2JC0TS46BH9RTYMEVQ7 is doing with no live claim; implementation author is codex-storyatlas-root. Candidate cand-2KZH2JA107QCVY6KMP7ZM3G4R4 freezes 7c7858f and has completed substantive review, but current reducer state is authorization_absent plus git_evidence_stale after later candidate proposals. It is not landed and no live producer currently owns its evidence refresh. Do not call this edge ready from the handoff note alone.

START 3, real proposition provider: bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG is doing with no live claim. The no-model contract cand-70 / 4393c3d is authored by new-engineer, formally approved, protected under rv-01M198ZAPAXRA59N0CSK7NNGTR, and blocked only on chief authorization. The REAL extractor has no candidate, claim, or approved public vocabulary yet. Scout has accepted conditional ownership after contract landing and exact-path/name approval in post-01M1995CPGYFYKA86228ZS1A55. Therefore the integration parent should name two separate edges: landed contract, then landed provider implementation with real coverage/abstention receipts.

START 4, transition missingness: bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ is doing with no live claim. Exact 7ee4872 is authored by scout; successor cand-7BD7 is formally approved and chief-authorized. It remains unlanded because ancestor_pending names the older same-commit row and current Git evidence is stale. Scout returned and reproduced that the exact same-commit supersede is rejected even by the original proposer; bd-01M1890HYQTY50KM80EB3C2ZKH owns the Mote defect. This edge is source-complete but not landed.

CLOSURE 5, calibration court: no existing bead currently owns the full predeclared external/refusal calibration protocol. bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 is m1-owned imputation/accounting work, not the calibration court. The parent should create a named child or explicit scope rather than treating W4 prose as ownership.

CLOSURE 6, eligible support: bd-01M166XWESBS1JZ5B38H0ZZ2DK is assigned to m1. Current cand-4CSV / d917218 is formally BLOCKED by the same-id recall-text and same-ref source-support substitution courts. m1 has acknowledged that the repair must bind coordinates to the actual scored recall/source view. This edge is owned and under repair, not ready.

CLOSURE 7, unforgeable receipts: bd-01M183VBPNEAPT5JNQMBMYMKQ9 is assigned to the chief. Thirty of thirty measured cases across the landed slices are forgeable; align and codec remain unswept/held behind batch work, and conversion/sealing has not landed. CostBreakdown and five align siblings also have the narrower open bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX. Name the chief-owned sweep plus the specific result-receipt acceptance condition; the probe count alone is not closure.

INTEGRATION PARENT: still absent. Movie-architecture owns the proposal and chief owns promotion/assignment. My recommendation is one parent with these seven explicit dependency edges and a separate implementation owner after promotion. Do not assign the parent to a prerequisite author by implication.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: refresh any foreign candidate evidence, claim a bead, land a SHA, or inspect participant data. This is a replay-derived ownership/readiness audit, with Git work left untouched.
